data.one_liner: A Flutter K-line and depth chart widget with drag, scale, and technical indicators.
data.what_it_does: Provides customizable K-line charts, time-sharing charts, and market depth charts for financial or crypto data. Supports user interactions like dragging, scaling, long-pressing, and displaying technical indicators.
use_when: You need to build a financial or cryptocurrency trading interface in Flutter.
You require customizable technical analysis indicators like MACD, RSI, BOLL, or KDJ on charts.
avoid_when: You need general-purpose charts like standard line, bar, or pie charts.
You do not have ordered historical financial data ready to process with DataUtil.
strengths: Supports interactions like dragging, scaling, flinging, and trend lines.
Includes built-in technical indicators and depth charts.
weaknesses: Limited documentation outside of the README example.
Specific to K-line financial use cases rather than general charting.

alternatives.name: fl_chart
alternatives.why_pick_it: Pick if you need a widely-used, highly customizable general charting library for line, bar, and pie charts.

alternatives.name: syncfusion_flutter_charts
alternatives.why_pick_it: Pick if you need robust, enterprise-grade charts with extensive built-in financial and technical indicator support.
